data.description: Reusable comparison schema for Australian travel insurance Product Disclosure Statements (PDS/FSG). A PDS may contain multiple plan tiers, trip-frequency variants, geographic scopes and optional add-ons; extraction should emit one record for each distinct plan/tier or purchasable product configuration described, preserving table evidence for limits, excesses, inclusions and exclusions.

coverage_categories.description: 24/7 assistance, emergency assistance services, medical transfer coordination and payment guarantees.
Emergency medical, hospital, surgical, ambulance, evacuation and repatriation expenses incurred overseas or away from home.
Emergency dental treatment, usually for pain relief or temporary restoration of function.
Cash allowance or incidentals payable for hospitalisation or confinement after a waiting period.
Funeral expenses, cremation, burial, return of mortal remains or ashes, including Schengen visa repatriation amounts.
Cancellation, amendment, lost deposits, unused prepaid travel and accommodation before departure.
On-trip cancellation, curtailment, trip interruption, cutting journey short and resumption of journey.
Additional accommodation, meals and transport expenses caused by illness, injury, transport disruption, lost documents, natural disaster or other insured events.
Travel delay expenses, usually accommodation or meals after a transport delay threshold.
Special event transport, festivals/gigs, conferences, weddings, funerals or other time-critical events.
Loss, theft or damage to luggage, baggage, personal effects, valuables and specified/high-value items.
Delayed, misplaced or misdirected checked baggage and emergency purchases.
Passports, travel documents, transaction cards, credit cards, replacement costs and fraudulent use where covered.
Cash, money, bank notes, travellers cheques or currency lost or stolen.
Rental car or rental vehicle insurance excess, deductible or damage liability fee reimbursement.
Legal liability to third parties for bodily injury, death or property damage.
Accidental death, permanent disability, total permanent disablement, loss of limb/sight and related lump sums.
Loss of income or wages after injury or disability arising during travel.
COVID-19 cover for medical expenses, cancellation, trip disruption, quarantine or related exclusions/sub-limits.
Cruise-specific cover, including onboard medical, ship-to-shore evacuation, cabin confinement, missed ports, shore excursions, formal wear and marine rescue diversion.
Winter sports cover, including ski equipment, equipment hire, ski pack/lift passes, piste/resort closure, avalanche and emergency rescue.
Adventure activities, sports packs, moped/motorcycle options, trekking, scuba, skydiving and other activity extensions.
Bicycle or e-bike cover and accessories where separately covered or excluded from standard luggage.
Business travel cover, business equipment, business money, emergency courier, alternative/replacement staff and business samples.
Legal expenses for pursuing compensation or defending covered proceedings, separate from personal liability defence costs.
Pet boarding, kennel/cattery fees, domestic pets, domestic services, childcare or household assistance benefits.
Hijacking, kidnap and ransom, detention or similar security-event benefits.
Inbound medical or dental expenses in Australia for non-Australian residents travelling to Australia.

fields.description: Required product classification for the extracted record. Use one of the schema product_types only. For annual/frequent traveller plans use international_multi_trip or domestic as appropriate; for business annual products use business; for inbound travel-to-Australia plans use inbound; for cruise-specific products or cruise cover records use cruise.
fields.name: product_type

fields.description: Trading brand or distributor name shown on the PDS, e.g. 1Cover, Cover-More, Commonwealth Bank, Southern Cross Travel Insurance, Insure&Go.
fields.name: brand_name

fields.description: Legal insurer or underwriter name and identifiers, including ABN, AFSL or overseas branch details where stated.
fields.name: insurer_name

fields.description: Issuer, underwriting agent, administrator, authorised representative or arranging entity where different from the insurer.
fields.name: issuer_or_agent_name

fields.description: Name of the travel insurance product or PDS product family, excluding individual plan tier where possible.
fields.name: product_name

fields.description: Plan, tier or variant name for this product record, e.g. Comprehensive, Essentials, Medical Only, Domestic, Inbound, Gold, Silver, Bare Essentials, Annual Multi-Trip, Overseas Frequent Traveller.
fields.name: plan_name

fields.description: Commercial tier or level of cover when the PDS groups plans into levels, e.g. Basic/Bare Essentials/Silver/Gold/Comprehensive/Essentials. Leave blank if plan_name already fully identifies the tier.
fields.name: cover_level

fields.description: PDS or combined PDS/FSG title as printed on the document cover or first pages.
fields.name: pds_title

fields.description: Effective date of the PDS or policy wording, normalised as ISO date when possible while preserving original wording in evidence.
fields.name: pds_effective_date

fields.description: Prepared, issue, version or document date if different from the effective date.
fields.name: pds_prepared_or_version_date

fields.description: Geographic scope sold for this plan, e.g. worldwide, worldwide excluding/including Americas, selected country/region, Australia only, travel to Australia, domestic cruising. Include destination-selection rules if embedded in the wording.
fields.name: geographic_scope

fields.description: Trip frequency covered by the plan.
fields.name: trip_frequency

fields.description: Whether the plan covers unlimited trips during a 12-month or annual period.
fields.name: annual_unlimited_trips

fields.description: Available maximum duration options for each journey/trip, expressed as a readable string when multiple options exist, e.g. 21/45 days, 30/60/90 days, 30/45/60 days.
fields.name: maximum_trip_duration_options

fields.description: Maximum journey/trip duration in days for this extracted record where a single value applies. If multiple selectable values exist, use maximum_trip_duration_options instead or emit separate records if the plan is priced/structured separately by duration.
fields.name: maximum_trip_duration_days

fields.description: Overall policy period in months, usually 12 for annual multi-trip policies.
fields.name: policy_period_months

fields.description: Minimum distance from home required for a domestic or annual multi-trip journey to be covered, in kilometres, where stated.
fields.name: minimum_distance_from_home_km

fields.description: Whether paid overnight accommodation can satisfy eligibility when travel is within the stated minimum distance from home.
fields.name: paid_accommodation_exception

fields.description: Eligibility and residency rules, including Australian resident/citizen/permanent resident, temporary resident, Medicare/private health/visa requirements, return-home requirement, already overseas rules and inbound non-resident rules.
fields.name: eligibility_rules

fields.description: Minimum applicant or traveller age in years if stated.
fields.name: minimum_age_years

fields.description: Maximum traveller age in years for the plan/tier at policy issue or application date. Use the strictest generally applicable plan limit; capture nuanced rules in age_eligibility_notes.
fields.name: maximum_age_years

fields.description: Age limit for accompanied/dependent children, if specified.
fields.name: dependent_child_age_limit_years

fields.description: Additional age-related eligibility notes, such as different limits by tier, reduced trip duration for older travellers, or benefits limited to age ranges.
fields.name: age_eligibility_notes

fields.description: Whether this plan can be purchased after the traveller has already left home/departure point, or while already overseas.
fields.name: already_travelling_or_overseas_available

fields.description: Waiting period in hours for cover after purchase or for specified benefits, if a single dominant waiting period is stated.
fields.name: waiting_period_hours

fields.description: Structured waiting period rules. Each object should include benefit/section, waiting period, trigger/start time, exceptions and evidence reference.
fields.name: waiting_period_rules

fields.description: Cooling-off/free-look period in days for cancellation refund rights.
fields.name: cooling_off_period_days

fields.description: Refund and policy cancellation rules after cooling-off, including administration fees and restrictions after travel starts or after a claim.
fields.name: policy_cancellation_refund_terms

fields.description: Available excess choices or selectable excess amounts, preserving wording such as nil, chosen excess, $50, $100, $250, double excess for winter sports, or per-event/per-person application.
fields.name: excess_options

fields.description: Standard or default excess amount in AUD where a single amount applies to the plan.
fields.name: standard_excess_aud

fields.description: Rules for how excess applies. Each object should include benefit/section, excess applies yes/no, amount if stated, per claim/event/person/policy, and evidence reference.
fields.name: excess_rules

fields.description: Emergency medical and hospital expenses limit as printed for medical/hospital/ambulance/evacuation expenses, e.g. Unlimited, $10,000,000, Nil, not covered. Do not include separate emergency dental, repatriation/funeral/remains limits or maximum months-from-onset duration where those can be captured in emergency_dental_limit, repatriation_of_remains_limit, or medical_expenses_max_months_from_onset; preserve footnotes in evidence.
fields.name: emergency_medical_limit

fields.description: Emergency dental treatment limit as printed, if separable from medical cover.
fields.name: emergency_dental_limit

fields.description: Cancellation, amendment, lost deposits or pre-departure cancellation limit as printed, including Chosen Limit, Cover chosen, Unlimited, Nil, or a dollar amount.
fields.name: cancellation_cover_limit

fields.description: Whether cancellation cover is optional/selectable rather than automatically included at a fixed amount.
fields.name: cancellation_cover_selectable

fields.description: On-trip additional accommodation, transport, disruption, curtailment or trip interruption limit as printed.
fields.name: additional_expenses_or_trip_disruption_limit

fields.description: Travel delay benefit limit as printed, including per-hour/per-day sub-limits if concise.
fields.name: travel_delay_limit

fields.description: Total luggage, baggage and personal effects limit as printed.
fields.name: luggage_limit

fields.description: General single-item, pair or set item limit for luggage/personal effects as printed. If categories differ, also populate sub_limits or coverage_benefits.
fields.name: luggage_single_item_limit

fields.description: Electronics, camera, laptop, phone, tablet, gadget or valuables limit/sub-limit as printed where prominent.
fields.name: electronics_or_valuables_limit

fields.description: Delayed luggage or baggage delay benefit limit as printed.
fields.name: luggage_delay_limit

fields.description: Travel documents, passport, transaction card or credit card replacement/fraudulent-use limit as printed.
fields.name: travel_documents_limit

fields.description: Money, cash, currency or travellers cheque limit as printed.
fields.name: money_limit

fields.description: Rental vehicle insurance excess/deductible/damage liability limit as printed, including optional increase amounts.
fields.name: rental_vehicle_excess_limit

fields.description: Personal liability limit as printed.
fields.name: personal_liability_limit

fields.description: Accidental death, disability, total permanent disablement or personal accident limit as printed. Use sub_limits for separate death/disability/loss-of-limb amounts.
fields.name: personal_accident_limit

fields.description: Loss of income benefit limit as printed, including weekly/monthly percentages and maximum duration if concise.
fields.name: loss_of_income_limit

fields.description: Whether the plan provides any COVID-19 cover beyond general pandemic exclusions.
fields.name: covid_cover_available

fields.description: COVID-19 medical expense limit as printed, if separately identified.
fields.name: covid_medical_limit

fields.description: COVID-19 cancellation, amendment, quarantine or trip disruption limit as printed, if separately identified.
fields.name: covid_cancellation_or_disruption_limit

fields.description: Concise summary of COVID-19 covered events and exclusions, e.g. positive diagnosis only, hospitalisation, life-threatening relative infection, no border closures/government bans, no close-contact-only claims.
fields.name: covid_cover_summary

fields.description: Cruise cover status for the plan.
fields.name: cruise_cover_status

fields.description: Whether cruise cover must be selected and paid for to cover multi-night cruise-related claims.
fields.name: cruise_cover_required_for_cruises

fields.description: Cruise-specific benefits. Each object should include benefit name, category, included yes/no, limit, excess, conditions, exclusions and source evidence/table cells.
fields.name: cruise_benefits

fields.description: Optional add-ons, packs, upgrades or amendments available for the plan, such as cruise, winter sports, adventure, motorcycle/moped, bicycle, high value items, electronic gadgets, natural disaster, business cover or rental vehicle excess increase. Each object should include add-on name, availability, limit changes, eligibility/age rules, waiting period, premium requirement and evidence.
fields.name: optional_add_ons

fields.description: All plan benefits from benefits tables and policy wording. Each object should include canonical coverage category, source section number/name, benefit name, included yes/no, limit text, excess applies, sub-limits, per-person/per-policy basis, conditions, exclusions and table/text evidence.
fields.name: coverage_benefits

fields.description: Sub-limits and item limits not already captured in major fields. Each object should include parent benefit, sub-limit name, amount, basis, trigger/waiting period and evidence.
fields.name: sub_limits

fields.description: Basis on which limits apply, e.g. per person, per adult, per policy, per journey, per trip, per item, per event, shared with dependants, reinstated each journey.
fields.name: limit_basis_notes

fields.description: Whether benefit limits are automatically reinstated after each journey on an annual or multi-trip policy.
fields.name: annual_limit_reinstatement

fields.description: Pre-existing medical condition cover approach.
fields.name: pre_existing_medical_cover_status

fields.description: Whether a medical assessment/screening is required to obtain cover for pre-existing medical conditions or pregnancy complications.
fields.name: medical_assessment_required

fields.description: Summary of the definition and treatment of pre-existing medical conditions, automatically included conditions, non-coverable conditions, undiagnosed conditions and additional premium/endorsement requirements.
fields.name: pre_existing_medical_conditions_summary

fields.description: Pregnancy cover summary, including covered complications, assisted conception/multiple pregnancy rules, childbirth/newborn exclusions and disclosure/screening requirements.
fields.name: pregnancy_cover_summary

fields.description: Latest gestational week up to which pregnancy-related cover may apply for a single pregnancy, expressed as a numeric week threshold where stated.
fields.name: pregnancy_single_week_limit

fields.description: Latest gestational week up to which pregnancy-related cover may apply for a multiple pregnancy, if different from single pregnancy.
fields.name: pregnancy_multiple_week_limit

fields.description: Rules for non-traveller relatives, business partners, travelling companions or relevant persons whose illness/death may trigger cancellation or curtailment, including age and pre-existing condition restrictions.
fields.name: non_traveller_health_rules

fields.description: Activities automatically included in cover. Each object should include activity, conditions, exclusions from liability/death benefits and evidence.
fields.name: included_activities

fields.description: Activities or sports that require an add-on, upgrade or pack. Each object should include activity, required add-on, conditions, excluded benefit sections and evidence.
fields.name: optional_activity_cover

fields.description: Activities, sports or travel arrangements excluded under all circumstances or unless specified add-on is purchased. Each object should include exclusion, scope and evidence.
fields.name: excluded_activities

fields.description: Rental vehicle eligibility and exclusions, including vehicle types, licence/nominated driver requirements, rental agreement requirements, unsealed/off-road exclusions, administration/loss-of-use exclusions and document requirements.
fields.name: rental_vehicle_excess_conditions

fields.description: Luggage and valuables conditions, including unattended property rules, locked vehicle/concealed storage limits, checked-in valuables exclusions, proof of ownership, depreciation, IMEI blocking and reporting deadlines.
fields.name: luggage_conditions

fields.description: Depreciation rules for personal effects or equipment claims. Each object should include item category, age band, depreciation percentage or payable percentage, maximum deduction and evidence.
fields.name: depreciation_rules

fields.description: Business-specific benefits and conditions such as business equipment, samples, business money, emergency courier, equipment hire, alternative/replacement staff, leisure travel allowance and business-purpose eligibility.
fields.name: business_cover_details

fields.description: Inbound-specific eligibility and benefits for non-Australian residents travelling to Australia, including medical expenses in Australia and exclusions for Medicare-eligible persons.
fields.name: inbound_cover_details

fields.description: General exclusions applicable to all benefits. Each object should include exclusion heading/name, description, exceptions, affected sections if specified and evidence reference.
fields.name: general_exclusions

fields.description: Benefit-specific exclusions. Each object should include benefit/section, exclusion text, exceptions and evidence reference.
fields.name: benefit_exclusions

fields.description: Travel-warning, sanction and embargo rules, including Smartraveller Do Not Travel/Reconsider advice, Cuba/Iran/Syria/North Korea/Ukraine regions, Antarctica rules and sanction limitations.
fields.name: travel_warning_and_sanctions_rules

fields.description: Claims process summary, including claim notification deadline, online/postal submission method, required supporting documents, emergency approval thresholds, payment currency and claim assessment timeframe.
fields.name: claims_process_summary

fields.description: Emergency assistance contact details and mandatory contact/approval thresholds, such as hospitalisation, surgery or medical expenses over a stated amount.
fields.name: emergency_assistance_details

fields.description: Factors the PDS says affect premium, such as destination, duration, age, plan, excess, number of travellers, cancellation amount and add-ons.
fields.name: premium_factors

fields.description: Source PDF path used for extraction.
fields.name: source_pdf_path

fields.description: Source PDF hash or document identifier used for traceability.
fields.name: source_pdf_hash

fields.description: Evidence supporting key extracted fields. Each object should include field name(s), page number, block/table id, exact quote or table cell(s), and any interpretation notes. Tables must be treated as first-class evidence.
fields.name: source_evidence
claim_notification_deadline_days
fields.description: General claim notification or claim registration deadline in days after return/completion of travel where stated. Use claims_process_summary or coverage-specific conditions for benefit-specific reporting deadlines such as 72-hour baggage reports.

fields.name: legal_expenses_limit
fields.description: Legal expenses benefit limit as printed for pursuing compensation, wrongful detention/arrest consultation, or similar legal-cost cover separate from personal liability defence costs.

fields.name: natural_disaster_cover_status
fields.description: Natural disaster cover status for cancellation, additional expenses or travel delay benefits at plan level. Use included where the plan covers natural disaster events without extra premium, optional_add_on where a natural-disaster upgrade must be purchased, conditionally_included where only some sections or specified circumstances are covered, excluded where natural disasters are not covered, not_applicable where the plan has no relevant benefits, or unknown. Capture section-specific differences in coverage_benefits or optional_add_ons.

fields.name: medical_expenses_max_months_from_onset
fields.description: Maximum number of months emergency medical/dental expenses cover may continue from onset of illness, condition or injury, where stated separately from the policy/trip duration.

fields.name: repatriation_of_remains_limit
fields.description: Funeral expenses, burial/cremation, return of body, ashes or mortal remains limit as printed, including Schengen visa EUR amounts and whether the limit is per person or per deceased person.

fields.name: travel_delay_minimum_delay_hours
fields.description: Minimum transport delay in hours before the travel delay benefit can be claimed for this plan/record. If thresholds differ by sub-benefit, use coverage_benefits or sub_limits for detail.

fields.name: travel_services_provider_insolvency_limit
fields.description: Travel services provider insolvency, financial default or financial collapse benefit limit/status as printed, e.g. $5,000, $10,000, Nil, excluded/not covered. Capture whether travel agent/tour operator insolvency is excluded in notes or coverage_benefits.

fields.name: winter_sports_cover_status
fields.description: Winter sports or snow sports cover status for the plan: included, optional add-on, separate plan/tier, excluded, not applicable, or unknown. Use detailed benefit limits and activity rules in coverage_benefits, optional_activity_cover and optional_add_ons.

notes: Use one extracted product record per distinct plan/tier described by a PDS. If a plan has materially different selectable trip durations, excesses or add-on configurations, capture options in the relevant option fields unless the comparison task requires separate records.

Use string limit fields to preserve values such as Unlimited, Nil, Included, Chosen Limit, Cover chosen, per-adult/per-policy footnotes, and foreign-currency Schengen amounts. Use coverage_benefits and sub_limits for detailed table-level comparison.
Cruise cover is modelled both as product_type=cruise when a cruise-specific product/record is emitted and as optional add-on/status fields where cruise cover modifies another travel insurance plan.
Car rental vehicle excess is a benefit category and field, not a separate car-insurance product type.
When evidence comes from Markdown tables, record the table id, row/column labels and cell text in source_evidence or the evidence fields inside list objects.
